title: RemoteHands WebSocket frames
description: Every message the core sends on /v1/ws is a Frame. Verify sig (contracts/vectors/ws_frames.json), check that payload.seq equals frame seq, then parse payload as a Payload. seq starts at 1 and grows by 1 per connection; after a reconnect the client reloads state over REST. Event types are added stage by stage.

payload.description: JSON text of a Payload; hashed as raw UTF-8 bytes

sig.description: Base64 DER signature by the core key over JCS {"v":1,"nonce":<ws.open nonce>,"seq":seq,"body":<sha256 hex of payload>}
